man, though idiotic, and knowing not what he does, yet full of the sweet things of love and gratitude

Pierre Louis Alexandre (he may have swedified is surname to Alexandersson at the end of his life) is probably one of the most portrayed non-royals in Swedish 19th century portraiture which is really cool.
It’s from the National Gallery of Art’s description!
One of the histories available about Pierre Louis Alexandre: www.athenaartfoundation.org/pierre-louis...
it’s all about the denominator, judge
read this yesterday and was immediately struck by that painting, it is indeed very cool

I also talk about insanely cool guy Albert O. Hirschman:

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/to-the-you...

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/to-the-you...
No lie: I was looking for other art and when I saw it I was like “I gotta get this thing in here”

To the young people booing AI graduation speakers, I salute you.

patient: but doctor.. i AM pagliacci

pagliacci (pretending to be a doctor to drum up business): you can just say you don't want to go to the show

From FCC chair Brendan Carr’s “Lunch with the FT” feature this weekend, which has gotten headlines for other things. 

But in this part it’s not clear to me that the person aggressively regulating your radio and TV actually consumes any radio or TV himself?

I ORDER MY COFFEE BLACK. NO SUGAR. NO MILK. NO WATER. NO CUP. THEY HAND ME THE BEANS. I EAT THEM IN THE PARKING LOT LIKE A HORSE. THE BARISTAS HAVE STOPPED CHARGING ME. I HAVE NOT SLEPT SINCE TUESDAY. I CAN HEAR THE WIFI
please remember all of us who will dislike Nolan's Odyssey for non-chud reasons.
every moment whole tons of ponderosity seemed added to the sinking bulk, and the ship seemed on the point of going over
Thank you brother Brian!
This probably will not have any unpredictable long-term effects on our society.
